about: avenBRAIN's package list (README.md): one item per package on Brain's dashboard, in the order a reader meets them, then the architecture, the decisions and the glossary. `page` is the file Brain shows for it: a package's is <id>/README.md. Its slides are shown in their place in its story, by the file name under <id>/slides/. `art` is the object drawn on its card (art/tiles.mjs; core, id and caps keep a slide's).

packages.name: avenCORE
packages.what: The primitives every package shares: Values, names, signed things, envelopes, logs and ops

packages.name: avenID
packages.what: Who is who: keys, signatures, sealing, vaults and their owners

packages.name: avenCAPS
packages.what: Who may do what: caps, and Maia City's register

packages.name: avenDOCS
packages.what: Data that merges: Docs, Records, types and lenses, with their history

packages.name: avenOPS
packages.what: Ops over Docs: queries, mutations and wants

packages.name: avenSTORE
packages.what: Where bytes rest: blobs, refs and files

packages.name: avenPEERS
packages.what: Running: the Peer, the Peer-Light, the wire, keepers and relays

packages.name: avenRUNTIME
packages.what: Frozen modules that run code and draw faces

packages.name: avenACTORS
packages.what: Programs that live in a Doc and take turns

packages.name: avenOS
packages.what: The shell: apps on a dashboard, acting as a vault

packages.name: avenSANDBOX
packages.what: The box: every peer on one machine, checked

packages.name: The architecture
packages.what: The whole on one page: the rules, the packages and every decision's status

packages.name: The decisions
packages.what: Every decision, in the order it was made

packages.name: The glossary
packages.what: Every term, with its one meaning
